label: Icon with Content
purpose: Icon paired with a heading and richtext description
_notes:
'icon' is free text — a Material Symbols icon name (e.g. check_circle, local_shipping, verified, star). 'image' optionally replaces it with an uploaded custom icon image (left empty by the AI per system prompt). filled_icon toggles solid vs outline icon style. icon_position changes composition: above the title+text, next to just the title, or next to both title and text. icon_heading_size sizes the 'title' field (h2 largest, h5 smallest). 'text' is richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. All remaining real settings (icon size, icon color, custom colors, text alignment, text size, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
